Audio transcription with explicit language hint

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.transcribe_async(LiterLlm::CreateTranscriptionRequest.new(file: 'audio_de.mp3', language: 'de', model: 'whisper-1'))
puts result.text.inspect
```
